package.name: rammp_ui_bridge_streaming
package.description: C++ RMSS camera-streaming node for rammp_ui_bridge: forwards the scene camera's raw color/depth frames and the active engine's validated overlay-camera frames (docs/NODE_INTERFACE.md §5.2.A) to UE's RMSS streaming server, as an optional replacement for ui_bridge_node's own Python-side forwarding (see that node's "use_python_camera_streaming"/"validated_engine_overlay_topic" params). Wire-compatible byte-for-byte with ramms_tools.streaming.StreamSender -- this package re-implements that one client-side class in C++, nothing else; ui_bridge_node remains the ui_control arbitration server and the source of the validated overlay feed this node subscribes to.
